vh-5-1-3-10.title: Smoke in the Mist
vh-5-1-3-10.text: Heavy vapor rolls down the terrace steps in grey tendrils, smelling strongly of woodsmoke and damp earth. Your shoulders ache under the steady, humming weight of the bronze clapper, its metal cold against the padding of your pack frame as you pause to catch your breath. The world has narrowed to the damp stone beneath your boots and the shifting shroud of white clouds that swallows the mountain edge.
exits: Squeeze past the frozen orchard trees ahead
Consult the weathered and blank wooden signpost
Listen closely beneath the dripping overhead branches

vh-5-1-3-11.title: Narrow Stone Passage
vh-5-1-3-11.text: Unencumbered by a pack animal's clumsy bulk, you slip sideways through a narrow gap between stone buttresses just as a rolling boulder crashes down the lane. Without the stubborn breadth of a mule to hinder your footing, you move with a nimble lightness that lets you navigate the tightest corners of the terrace. The air here tastes sharply of pine resin and wet rock, untainted by animal sweat or heavy harness.
exits: Examine the weathered signpost in the mist
Proceed carefully past the curtain of dripping leaves

vh-5-1-3-12.title: The Leaping Trout
vh-5-1-3-12.text: A rusted wind-vane shaped like a leaping trout creaks dismally atop a rotting wooden post. Below it, the path splits into a web of slick stone alleys veiled in dense mountain fog. The metallic groan of the weather-vane echoes strangely in the quiet air, competing only with the distant, melancholy drop of water from the eaves above.
exits: Step cautiously beneath the dripping branch-curtain
Follow the draft toward the smell of roasting chestnuts

vh-5-1-3-13.title: The Foggy Margin
vh-5-1-3-13.text:
Yellowed dock leaves brush against your knees as you skirt a patch of boggy ground near the lower terrace, each step sinking ankle-deep into cold, peat-scented muck that tries to pull your boots down. The bronze Clapper on your back shifts its weight, a dull, reassuring hum against your spine that counterbalances the damp chill rising through your woolen trousers. Through the grey mist overhead, heavy drops of moisture begin to fall from the leaf-laden boughs, pattering steadily against your leather pack.

Two separate trails diverge from this soggy hollow: one narrow track plunges deeper into the dripping thicket where a curtain of falling water masks the path, while the other winds toward a stone wall where the sharp tang of woodsmoke drifts on a sudden mountain draft.
exits: Follow the path behind the dripping water curtain
Head toward the wall smelling of woodsmoke

vh-5-1-3-14.title: The Crumbling Kiln
vh-5-1-3-14.text: A crumbling brick kiln emits a faint, lingering heat that thaws the ice on your stiffened leather gloves. You stand close to the warm masonry for a moment, letting the gentle radiation soothe your aching muscles while the great bronze clapper hums softly against your spine. Wisps of steam rise from your damp wool cloak as the surrounding fog presses in with a silent, heavy stillness.
exits: Head toward the blind wooden signpost
Follow the cold draft toward the roasting chestnuts

vh-5-1-3-15.title: Wool and Woodsmoke
vh-5-1-3-15.text: The damp air tastes of wood-smoke and wet wool, signaling the proximity of inhabited stone shelters ahead. You adjust the padded straps holding the heavy bronze tongue, feeling its familiar, low resonance thrum through your ribs. The path grows firmer beneath your soles, paving stones smoothed by generations of orchard-keepers and travelers heading down the mountain.
exits: Proceed past the curtain of dripping branches
Follow the chill draft toward the shelter smells

vh-5-1-4-0.title: The Fern Arch
vh-5-1-4-0.text: A low stone archway dripping with green maidenhair fern frames the gravel path leading toward the guard post. The masonry is slick with moisture, and tiny droplets cling to the delicate fronds like beads of glass. Through the damp aperture, the faint outline of a low-roofed stone building looms in the thick white haze of the orchard valley.
exits: Approach the glowing horn windows of the shelter

vh-5-1-4-1.title: The Bone Whistle
vh-5-1-4-1.text: The muffled sound of a bone whistle echoes off the wet cliffs, warning that the checkpoint is near. You halt for a heartbeat, listening to the shrill, bird-like notes dance through the fog and vanish into the damp evergreens. The heavy bronze clapper shifts slightly in its cradle, its metallic thrum harmonising with the lingering vibration of the guard's call.
exits: Walk toward the flickering lantern light ahead
Inspect the notched wooden tally stick by the door

vh-5-1-4-2.title: Piles of Birch Logs
vh-5-1-4-2.text: Piles of split birch logs line the narrow track, smelling of fresh sap and winter fuel stores. The white bark gleams softly against the grey stone walls as the fog drifts slowly between the stacked wood. Each log is cut to a precise measure, ready to keep the upcoming guard post warm against the biting mountain chill.
exits: Approach the glowing horn-windowed shelter
Check the wooden tally stick hanging by the latch
Warm your chilled hands near the wool blankets

vh-5-1-4-3.title: The Hemp Handrail
vh-5-1-4-3.text: A frayed hemp rope tied to a stump serves as a handrail above a steep drop into the white fog. The thick fibres are wet to the touch, and you grip them firmly to steady your balance against the pull of the heavy bronze burden on your back. Below the path, the abyss remains entirely hidden behind an opaque wall of cloud and mist.
exits: Make your way toward the lantern-lit window
Examine the transit toll tallies by the entrance
Turn back along the misty retaining wall
